userStories.title: Classifier module with strict JSON output
acceptanceCriteria: praxis/behavior/aug_auto.py exposes classify_session(transcript_text: str) -> AugAutoResult with fields classification ('augmentation'|'automation'|'mixed'), confidence (float 0..1), rationale (str).
The module uses Haiku 4.5 when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set, else gpt-5-mini, mirroring the existing provider selection in models_advisor; provider is chosen at call time, not at import time.
If the LLM returns malformed JSON or a classification value outside the three literals, classify_session raises a clearly-named AugAutoParseError; callers must handle it.
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis

userStories.title: Orchestrator integration with graceful degradation
acceptanceCriteria: praxis/orchestrator.py invokes classify_session once per session during pass-1, alongside the existing rubric judge call; the result is written via the new aug_auto profile_store helpers.
When no API key is available for the chosen provider, the orchestrator logs a single info-level message per run and writes NULL for both aug_auto columns, without aborting the rest of the pipeline.
On AugAutoParseError, the orchestrator records NULL for both aug_auto columns for that session, logs the rationale text, and continues the rest of the run instead of failing.
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis

userStories.title: Per-week aggregation helper
acceptanceCriteria: aug_auto.py exposes aggregate_for_week(profile_store, week_iso) -> AugAutoWeekSummary returning counts per category, share-of-total, and a 'classifier_unavailable' flag when every row in the week is NULL.
aggregate_for_week treats NULL rows as 'unclassified' (separate bucket) rather than dropping them, so totals always equal the count of session_scores in the week.
Calling aggregate_for_week with a week_iso that has zero session_scores returns a summary with all zeros and classifier_unavailable=False (not True).
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis
